title: IRS Kills Off  Popular Free Direct File Option For The 2026 Tax Filing Season
summary: While the IRS hasn’t officially confirmed that the program is dead, the website indicates that the program is closed—and states have been notified that it will not be in place for 2026.

title: Crypto Selloff, REKT Dip, Monad Launch, & DAT trades!
